findings.where: Client portal and office: adding a third series after formation
findings.claims: A client whose formation completes with two series pays the full price to add a third; there is no credit for it.
findings.truth: Owner, 12 Oct 2026: "Forget the whole coupon code idea. Just make sure the third series credit works". Owner-approved terms: a paid package whose formation completes with exactly two series gets one non-expiring, non-transferable credit toward a third; a training client gets none. Implement this.
findings.replacement: One credit per qualifying formation: the add-series dialog shows $0.00 and the portal shows "1 included series remaining"; a credit-backed request is $0, goes in progress with no payment, and the office sees it on the board; the credit is used when the office fulfills the series.

findings.claims: An order may be placed with one series; the form and the server accept it.
findings.truth: Owner approved the wording "Add at least two series to continue." (12 Oct 2026, "Approve 1") for a two-series minimum, so that every paid package ends with two series and the third is the credit.
findings.replacement: Require at least two series in the form and on the server, with the approved message.
